1	# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
2	#
3	#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
4	#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
5	#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
6	#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
7	#
8	# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
9	# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"
10	
11	fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
12	ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }
13	
14	expect() {
15	  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
16	  local out rc
17	  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
18	  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
19	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
20	}
21	
22	# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
23	_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
24	
25	# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
26	# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
27	cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }
28	
29	# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
30	# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env ("" when neither is set).
31	vsim_bin_dir() {
32	  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
33	  cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR
34	}

1	# Shared path resolution for the top-level e2e harness + drivers.
2	# Sourced (not executed). Provides:
3	#   TOP_ROOT                  - absolute path of the repo root
4	#   hybrid_resolve_paths()    - sets VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN,
5	#                               VSIM_ELF from TOP_ROOT (unless already
6	#                               exported by caller) and exits 77 (CTest
7	#                               skip) if any artifact is missing. Reads
8	#                               FIXTURE for the VSIM_ELF default.
9	#   hybrid_describe_int F [BIN] - print integer field F from an engine's
10	#                               --describe JSON (BIN defaults to $VSIM_BIN);
11	#                               empty output if absent/unprobeable. The ONE
12	#                               shell parser of the descriptor wire format.
13	
14	TESTS_LIB_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
15	TOP_ROOT=$(cd -- "$TESTS_LIB_DIR/../.." && pwd)
16	
17	if [ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" ] && [ -f "$TOP_ROOT/config.env" ]; then
18	  . "$TOP_ROOT/config.env"
19	fi
20	
21	hybrid_resolve_paths() {
22	  # VSIM_BIN_DIR / QEMU_BIN_DIR come from the environment or from the
23	  # config.env sourced above; there is no in-tree fallback (both simulators
24	  # are external prebuilts). Unset -> a nonexistent path -> skip below.
25	  VSIM_BIN="${VSIM_BIN:-${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}/sim_ax45mpv_premium}"
26	  VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}/qemu-system-riscv64}"
27	  VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$TOP_ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"
28	  VSIM_ELF="${VSIM_ELF:-$TOP_ROOT/tests/fixtures/${FIXTURE}.elf}"
29	  for f in "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_QEMU" "$VSIM_PLUGIN" "$VSIM_ELF"; do
30	    if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
31	      echo "skip: $f not built; run 'source ./setup.sh' and 'make -C tests/fixtures'"
32	      exit 77
33	    fi
34	  done
35	}
36	
37	# Extract one integer field from an engine's --describe JSON. $1 = field name,
38	# $2 = engine binary (default $VSIM_BIN). Prints nothing when the field is
39	# absent or the binary cannot be probed, so callers can `[ -n ... ]`-gate.
40	hybrid_describe_int() {
41	  "${2:-$VSIM_BIN}" --describe 2>/dev/null \
42	    | sed -n "s/.*\"$1\": *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p" | head -n1
43	}
44	
45	# Write a 32-bit little-endian word into a binary file (pattern staging for
46	# the LM/HVM backdoor-load tests). $1 = file, $2 = byte offset, $3 = value.
47	put_word_le() {
48	  local v=$3 bytes="" i
49	  for i in 0 8 16 24; do
50	    bytes+=$(printf '\\x%02x' $(( (v >> i) & 0xff )))
51	  done
52	  # shellcheck disable=SC2059
53	  printf "$bytes" | dd of="$1" bs=1 seek="$2" conv=notrunc status=none
54	}

5	# prints "file io ok" and exits 0. Run in a scratch cwd; the tmp file must
6	# be gone afterwards (remove() worked host-side).
7	set -uo pipefail

10	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)

25	run_leg() {  # LABEL CMD...
26	  local label="$1"; shift
27	  local wd out rc
28	  wd=$(mktemp -d)
29	  out=$( cd "$wd" && timeout 120 "$@" </dev/null 2>&1 ); rc=$?
30	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'file io ok' \
31	    || { rm -rf "$wd"; fail "$label: missing 'file io ok': $out"; }
32	  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { rm -rf "$wd"; fail "$label: exit code $rc != 0"; }
33	  [ ! -e "$wd/vplat_file_test.tmp" ] \
34	    || { rm -rf "$wd"; fail "$label: tmp file not removed"; }

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# F7 contract: `run --mode fast` -- QEMU-only, transparent passthrough.
3	# Three layers:
4	#
5	#   1. run-test (unit, fast): passthrough_argv fills the qemu `standalone`
6	#      invoke template ({bin}/{elf}) and appends the post-`--` engine args
7	#      verbatim -- including a `-gdb tcp::N -S` gdbstub. Pure, no spawn.
8	#   2. CLI error paths (no engine needed): missing --mode, unknown model,
9	#      missing ELF, an extra positional, and engine!=qemu each exit 2 with a
10	#      clear message.
11	#   3. real passthrough (needs built qemu + a fixture): launch
12	#      `run --mode fast ELF -- -gdb tcp::PORT -S`; the gdbstub port opens and
13	#      qemu halts at reset -- the done-when "port opens, halts, debugger
14	#      connects". exec_passthrough's exit-code propagation is already covered
15	#      by the F5 infra test (and observed here only indirectly).
16	set -uo pipefail
17	
18	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
19	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
20	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
21	
22	BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
23	RUNTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-run-test"
24	
25	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
26	
27	# 1. unit: the argv-assembly contract carries the passthrough behavior
28	[ -x "$RUNTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $RUNTEST"
29	"$RUNTEST" || fail "run unit tests (passthrough_argv) failed"
30	
31	# assert `$BIN run ...` exits with $1 and its combined output matches regex $2
32	expect_rc_match() {
33	  local want_rc="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
34	  local out rc
35	  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
36	  [ "$rc" -eq "$want_rc" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want_rc for [$*]: $out"
37	  echo "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "output missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
38	}
39	
40	# 2. CLI error paths (deterministic; no qemu)
41	expect_rc_match 2 'mode .* is required.*--help' "$BIN" run
42	expect_rc_match 2 "unknown model 'bogus'"    "$BIN" run --mode bogus p.elf
43	expect_rc_match 2 'missing ELF.*workload'     "$BIN" run --mode fast
44	expect_rc_match 2 'engine args go after --'  "$BIN" run --mode fast a.elf b.elf
45	expect_rc_match 2 "engine must be 'qemu64' or 'qemu32'" "$BIN" run --mode fast --engine vsim:x p.elf
46	
47	# 3. real passthrough: a frozen-at-reset gdbstub port opens (guarded on artifacts)
48	QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-$(cfg_val QEMU_BIN_DIR)}/qemu-system-riscv64}"
49	ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf"
50	if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -f "$ELF" ]; then
51	  PORT=$(( 40000 + (RANDOM % 20000) ))
52	  BG=""
53	  cleanup() { [ -n "${BG:-}" ] && kill "$BG" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "tcp::$PORT" 2>/dev/null; true; }
54	  trap cleanup EXIT
55	  # -S halts the cpu at reset, so the stub listens regardless of the ELF body.
56	  "$BIN" run --mode fast "$ELF" -- -gdb "tcp::$PORT" -S </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
57	  BG=$!
58	  opened=0
59	  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
60	    if timeout 1 bash -c ">/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then opened=1; break; fi
61	    sleep 0.25
62	  done
63	  cleanup; trap - EXIT; wait "$BG" 2>/dev/null
64	  [ "$opened" -eq 1 ] || fail "fast passthrough: gdbstub port $PORT never opened"
65	  echo "[ok] real fast passthrough: qemu gdbstub halted + listening on :$PORT"
66	else
67	  echo "[skip] real fast run: qemu and/or fixture not built ($QEMU / $ELF)"
68	fi

70	ok "F7 run --mode fast"
